operations.description: Delete an assessment. Long-running operation — returns 202 with a polling header, then 204 once the assessment and its rules have been removed and any rule side-effects undone. Authorized to the parent resource provider; the billing-account lifecycle also removes assessments automatically when the account is gone.
operations.name: Microsoft.BillingTrust/assessments/delete

operations.description: Create or update an Assessment. Long-running operation — returns 200 (replace) or 201 (create) with the `Azure-AsyncOperation` polling header on both responses.
operations.name: Microsoft.BillingTrust/assessments/write

operations.description: Request a time-bound, principal-bound upload token for supplemental document uploads.
operations.name: Microsoft.BillingTrust/assessments/listUploadToken/action

operations.description: Update an assessment. The only patchable property is `draft`; evaluation/provisioning state and `error` are server-owned. Synchronous PATCH — the `draft` list is replaced wholesale (send `[]` to clear). The value is stored in service state and returned on read only under `?$expandCustomerData=true`; it is omitted from the default read response.
operations.name: Microsoft.BillingTrust/assessments/write

operations.description: Request a time-bound, principal-bound upload token for a supplemental / appeal document. Returns the token and a pre-assigned document id; the document's type is bound later, when it is submitted via the rule `appeal` action.
operations.name: Microsoft.BillingTrust/assessments/listUploadToken/action

operations.description: Update a Rule. The PATCH body is discriminated by `kind` and must match the existing rule's kind. For `eduQualification` rules, only `supplementalDocuments` is patchable, and only when `evaluationState == actionRequired`. For `businessVerification` rules, the patchable fields are `supplementalDocuments` and `externalId`, and only when `evaluationState` is `pending` or `actionRequired`. For `uboVerification` rules, the only patchable field is `attestation`, and only when `evaluationState` is `actionRequired` or `failed`; submitting a PATCH re-triggers provider evaluation of the UBO rule and resets downstream dependent rules. The UBO `users` list and `businessOwnership` are both server-provided (`users` from the configured provider, `businessOwnership` from the billing account sold-to) — neither is patchable. `payeeVerification`, `remQualification`, and `legalContactVerification` have no patchable fields today; PATCH on those kinds is rejected with 400 InvalidParameterValue. All other field/state combinations are rejected with 400 InvalidParameterValue or 409 RuleNotActionable.
operations.name: Microsoft.BillingTrust/assessments/rules/write

operations.description:
Create or update a Rule. Rules are created by the service when the parent
assessment is created; they are not directly creatable by end users. Customer
PUT calls are rejected at runtime with `OperationNotAllowed`. Use PATCH to
modify rule fields that the customer is authorized to change.
operations.name: Microsoft.BillingTrust/assessments/rules/write

operations.description:
Appeal a rule's failed outcome by submitting a set of previously-uploaded
documents (typically one per reviewer-requested document type). Accepted
synchronously when the rule is `appealable` and the documents are valid; the
rule then scans the documents, forwards them to the verification provider, and
transitions to `underReview` asynchronously. Rejected when the rule is not
`appealable` or a document type is not among `documentTypeCodes`.
operations.name: Microsoft.BillingTrust/assessments/rules/appeal/action

operations.description: Start identity verification (IDV) for one or more of a `uboVerification` rule's individuals. Each directive targets an already-resolved UBO (by its `id` from `users[].id`) and drives that individual through the provider's identity-verification flow: `generateLink` returns a link; `sendSms` also sends the link to the individual via SMS. Returns the per-individual outcome (generated link, whether an SMS was sent, and the resulting state). Valid only for `uboVerification` rules while the rule is awaiting identity verification or has failed; it does NOT re-run business verification. Rejected with 400 InvalidParameterValue (wrong kind or invalid directive) or 409 RuleNotActionable (wrong state).
operations.name: Microsoft.BillingTrust/assessments/rules/startIndividualVerification/action
